title.zh: Anthropic推出基于Claude Opus 5.5的AI助手Claude Duet
title.en: Anthropic launches Claude Duet AI assistant powered by Claude Opus 5.5

current_state.zh: Anthropic 推出研究预览版 Claude Duet，这是一款基于 Claude Opus 5.5 构建的主动式智能体助手，运行在自带浏览器的云虚拟机中，可提供每日简报、通过 6000 多个连接器执行多步骤业务任务，敏感操作需用户明确批准，同时禁止证券交易和账户转账等操作。
current_state.en: Anthropic launched Claude Duet in research preview, a proactive agentic assistant built on Claude Opus 5.5 that runs in a cloud VM with its own browser, delivers daily briefings, executes multi-step business tasks across 6,000+ connectors, and requires explicit user approval for sensitive actions while prohibiting others such as securities trading and account transfers.

updates.what_changed_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Duet，这是一款由 Opus 5.5 驱动的新 AI 个人助手产品，引发 Hacker News 对其能力、用例和推理成本优势的讨论。
updates.what_changed_en: Anthropic introduced Claude Duet, a new AI personal-assistant product powered by Opus 5.5, prompting Hacker News discussion of its capabilities, use cases, and inference-cost advantages.
